# --- Ports (isolated; never the monorepo reserved 8787/5173/1080) ---

UI_PORT=5411
MAILDEV_UI_PORT=1311

OPENAI_API_KEY=

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=
MISTRAL_API_KEY=

# demo — Docker-first dev tooling (scaffolded by @sentropic/build-cli).
# Compose project name = the app slug (demo); ports come from .env.

COMPOSE ?= docker compose

.PHONY: help dev down typecheck build logs

help: ## Show this help
	@grep -E '^[a-zA-Z_-]+:.*?## .*$$' $(MAKEFILE_LIST) | awk 'BEGIN{FS=":.*?## "}{printf "  %-12s %s\n", $$1, $$2}'

dev: ## Build + start the backend and UI (Docker Compose)
	$(COMPOSE) up --build

down: ## Stop and remove the app's containers + volumes
	$(COMPOSE) down -v

logs: ## Tail service logs
	$(COMPOSE) logs -f

typecheck: ## Type-check backend + UI
	$(COMPOSE) run --rm --no-deps api sh -lc "npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run typecheck"
	$(COMPOSE) run --rm --no-deps ui sh -lc "npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run check"

build: ## Build backend + UI for production
	$(COMPOSE) run --rm --no-deps api sh -lc "npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build"
	$(COMPOSE) run --rm --no-deps ui sh -lc "npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build"

# demo

A runnable chat application scaffolded with [`@sentropic/build-cli`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sentropic/build-cli)
(`stp app init`). It is a two-tier app:

- **Backend** (`api/`) — a minimal [Hono](https://hono.dev) server that mounts the published
  [`@sentropic/chat-server`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sentropic/chat-server) **canonical**
  routes (`POST/GET /chat/sessions/:id/{messages,bootstrap}`, `GET /chat/sessions/:id/stream`)
  over an **in-memory** adapter. No Postgres, no provider key required: it replies with a
  deterministic offline message out of the box.
- **Web UI** (`ui/`) — a [Svelte 5](https://svelte.dev) app embedding
  [`@sentropic/chat-ui`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sentropic/chat-ui)'s `ChatPanel`, wired to
  the backend with `createDefaultTransport(VITE_API_BASE_URL)`, styled with the published
  [`@sentropic/design-system-svelte`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sentropic/design-system-svelte)
  + themes + tokens.

## Quick start (Docker-first)

```sh
cp .env.example .env   # ports + provider slots (already filled with sane defaults)
make dev               # build + start backend + UI
```

Then open the UI at <http://localhost:5411>. Send a message — it streams an assistant
reply from the backend over `GET /chat/sessions/:id/stream`.

| Service | URL |
|---|---|
| UI      | http://localhost:5411 |
| Backend | http://localhost:9211 |

Stop everything with `make down`.

## Make targets

| Target | What it does |
|---|---|
| `make dev`       | Build + start the backend and UI (Docker Compose). |
| `make down`      | Stop and remove the app's containers. |
| `make typecheck` | Type-check the backend and UI. |
| `make build`     | Build the backend and UI for production. |

## Switching to a real provider

The default `PROVIDER=stub` is a deterministic, offline reply. To use a real model, set
`PROVIDER` in `.env` to one of `openai` / `gemini` / `anthropic` / `mistral` / `cohere` and fill
the matching key slot, then restart `make dev`.

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "NodeNext",
    "moduleResolution": "NodeNext",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "rootDir": "src",
    "outDir": "dist",
    "strict": true,
    "declaration": false,
    "sourceMap": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "allowImportingTsExtensions": false,
    "verbatimModuleSyntax": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*.ts"],
  "exclude": ["dist/**", "node_modules/**"]
}

# Isolated compose project for the generated app.
# Project name = the app slug so two scaffolded apps (or another local dev stack)
# never collide. Ports come from .env (see .env.example) and are isolated per app.
name: demo

services:
  api:
    image: node:22-alpine
    working_dir: /app
    command: sh -lc "npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run dev"
    environment:
      - PORT=${API_PORT:-9211}
      - PROVIDER=${PROVIDER:-stub}
    ports:
      - "${API_PORT:-9211}:9211"
    volumes:
      - ./api:/app
      - api_node_modules:/app/node_modules

  ui:
    image: node:22-alpine
    working_dir: /app
    command: sh -lc "npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5411"
    environment:
      - VITE_API_BASE_URL=${VITE_API_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:9211}
    ports:
      - "${UI_PORT:-5411}:5411"
    volumes:
      - ./ui:/app
      - ui_node_modules:/app/node_modules
    depends_on:
      - api

volumes:
  api_node_modules:
  ui_node_modules:
